definitions.explanation: A television program featuring fictional characters and storylines.
An exciting, emotional, or unexpected situation.

notes:
USAGE: ドラマ in Japanese primarily refers to TV drama series. The theatrical/stage meaning is less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ドラマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch a drama)
・⟦{連続|れんぞく}ドラマ→連続ドラマ：26398_renzokudorama⟧ (TV series)
・⟦{朝|あさ}ドラ→朝ドラ：noentry⟧ (morning drama - NHK morning series)
・⟦{韓国|かんこく}→韓国：19417_kankoku⟧ドラマ (Korean drama)
・⟦ドラマチック→ドラマチック：noentry⟧ (dramatic)
